newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel space, defence turnover soars.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel space, defence turnover soars.

text.p: Turnover at Alcatel Alsthom's radiocommunications, space and defence division jumped sharply last year to 10.65 billion francs from 8.54 billion in 1995, division chairman Jean-Claude Husson said on Wednesday.
The division was profitable, Husson told reporters during a media tour of the division's facilities in the southern city of Toulouse, but he declined to furnish figures.
Husson said space activities accounted for 4.0 billion francs of 1996 turnover including 2.8 billion for Alcatel Unit Alcatel Espace.

He said he expected space-related sales to increase by 20 percent a year until the year 2000, when they should reach more than 8 billion francs. He said he expected his strategic plan to hold up even if Alcatel failed to acquire the state's 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF, which it is seeking.
If Alcatel's bid succeeded, "that would reinforce" the division's development, he said.
